title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues Concerning the Legal Supervision by the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps over Cases Heard by the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
June 14, 2006
Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues Concerning the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps
Exercising Legal Supervision over the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
Production and Construction Corps Branch in the Trial of Cases
and Related Issues
(On June 7, 2006, the Tenth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate
55th Session adopted)
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2006] No. 1
People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:
We have received your "Request for Instructions on Issues Concerning Exercising Legal Supervision over Cases Tried by the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region" (Xin Bing Jian Fa [2005] No. 23). Upon study, we hereby reply as follows:
When the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps considers that there is a definite error in the judgment or ruling of first instance in criminal cases rendered by the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, or if the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps discovers that there is a definite error in a legally effective judgment or ruling of the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, it may submit a protest to the Supreme People's Procuratorate.
This reply is given.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
June 14, 2006
